headline: Brokers recover as trading volume surges; Thai stocks lead brokerage business recovery
summary: Thailand's brokerage business is recovering, with average daily trading volume above 55,000 million baht. Most operators have passed break-even and returned to profit, led by Thai stocks.
why: Brokerage volumes track market activity and trading fees, which are a core revenue source for securities firms.
